profile.headline: Senior Gameplay Engineer at Riot Games | B.S. Caltech
profile.summary:
I play, code, and love League of Legends :D

"How" is my least favorite question word, and my favorite question word is "why".

Many times, I answer both with "I don't know," for slightly different sets of reasons with an overlap.

I appreciate well-thought-out, thought-provoking questions that create a joyful spark.

Here is my favorite excerpt from a book: "Radical Conservatism - the humble discipline of respecting the facts and learning from Nature with the systematic chutzpah of using what you think you've learned aggressively, applying it everywhere you can, even in situations that go beyond your original evidence. If it works, then you've discovered something useful; if it doesn't, then you've learned something important."

Senior Gameplay Engineer at Riot Games
B.S. in Computer Science and Business Economics at Caltech
Minor in Data Science

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Gameplay engineer intern on League of Legends - Player Immersion and Expression

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Added Competitor Profiles feature to Hearthstone Esports site, which provides detailed analytics on professional players' performance and tournament information (Express.js and React.js)
- Spearheaded site-wide CMS migration by creating services to integrate new content schema and developing a Node.js library to automate porting data

positions.title: Computer Vision Research Intern
positions.description:
- Developed image processing programs to evaluate the Mars 2020 Lander Vision System field test reference maps over Death Valley regions
- Created analysis and visualization tools for test data by utilizing various computer vision techniques including feature detection, template matching, camera projection, and homography
- Successfully identified the correct source of errors which had remained unknown for several years

honors.title: Henry Ford II Scholar Award
honors.issuer: Issued by California Institute of Technology · May 2020

projects.title: Game Boy Emulator
projects.description: Emulator of the original Game Boy by Nintendo written in C++

projects.title: Poem Generation using Machine Learning
projects.description:
- Wrote an unsupervised Hidden Markov Model using the Baum-Welch algorithm
- Trained the model to generate Shakespearean sonnets preserving iambic pentamer and rhymes
